title: CHOOSE THE MONEY OR THE FAMILY! 🤑

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: BURN THE DOCUMENTS OR I WILL MAKE SURE NONE OF YOU SEE A SINGLE PENNY [beat] FROM THIS CURSED ESTATE!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Uncle Jamal, you're literally shaking [beat] and I know it's not because you're cold in this dusty old attic [beat] it's because you're terrified of the truth!

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: Nix, honey, don't provoke him [beat] he is holding the only copy of the real will [beat] and he looks like he is about to snap at any second!

lines.speaker: phupu
lines.text: I always knew your side of the family was greedy [beat] but destroying a dead man's legacy just to hide your own debts is a new low [beat] even for you, Jamal!

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: Shut your mouth, Phupu [beat] you have been leeching off this family for years while I did the dirty work [beat] to keep this name respectable and clean!

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: Keeping the name respectable [beat] or keeping the police away from those offshore accounts [beat] that Grandpa mentioned in his final handwritten letter?

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: Here is the final offer [beat] sign this waiver right now [beat] and I will give each of you ten million dollars in cold cash by sunset today!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Ten million sounds like a lot of money [beat] until you realize the gold bars hidden behind that false wall [beat] are worth fifty times that much!

lines.speaker: phupu
lines.text: Fifty times? [beat] You arrogant snake, you were going to bribe us with crumbs [beat] while you walked away with the entire mountain of grandfather's gold!

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: If I can't have it [beat] then nobody is leaving this attic with anything but ashes [beat] because I have already opened the gas valves downstairs!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Wait, you actually rigged the entire house to explode [beat] just to win a family argument about money? [beat] You have completely lost your mind, Jamal!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The sharp smell of sulfur filled the room [beat] as Jamal pulled out a silver lighter [beat] looking at his family with a hollow, empty smile.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Jamal, put the lighter down [beat] we can talk about this [beat] but if you flick that thumb, we are all going to meet Grandpa much sooner than expected!
